title: Index of a user's documents (users/<slug>/sources.yaml)
description: Output of stage 02_triage: what each uploaded document is, read together with the others. evidence: about the person, to extract; context: about the organisation or the role, read while extracting, never a source of facts; duplicate: the same content as another document (another language, another format), extracted once through the primary; irrelevant: nothing a CV could use. Kept as the record of why a document was or was not extracted.

about.description: One line: what the document is and why it got this kind

duplicate_of.description: The primary document, for a duplicate

context_for.description: Documents or experience ids this context informs

note.description: The evidence note extracted from it, once it exists
